title: Welcome to the DSCC Family.
description: Meet other members, share your ideas, ask questions and take part in what we are building together.
content:
DSCC is a student-led community for curious minds who want to learn, experiment, collaborate and turn ideas into real experiences.

Start by introducing yourself, joining a workshop or sharing a project you are exploring. Every connection can become a new idea, a new project or a new opportunity.

Meet students who are exploring the same technologies, share questions and resources with the community, and take part in workshops, projects and events throughout the year.

title: OpenLab project ideas are open
description: Have an idea worth exploring? Bring it to OpenLab and find collaborators to help move it forward.
content:
OpenLab is a shared space for turning interesting questions into practical student projects. You do not need a complete plan before you start.

Share what you would like to explore, the skills you want to practice and the kind of collaborators you are looking for.
